notes.title: Day 0 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Ok, apparently I'm allergic to taking time off.
We've discovered a couple of bugs related to scenes & materials.
It was a quick fix, and was changed.

[list]
[*]Debug objects removed from GoSplat scene
[*]Material transparency adjusted.
[*]Fixed a rare silent error when changing shapes at the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: ChatBattlers has Released!
notes.notes:
It has been 6 Months, a Fantastic Weekend at TwitchCon where we met over 1000 people.
Almost 500 Commits
2 Engineers, a tech artist, a 2d artist.
Multiple contracted audio studios.

We've finally launched with our "Walking in a Winter WTF?"
Sing it, trust me, it's catchy. ːsteammockingː

We have an entire year of features coming for different seasons; skins, shapes, weapons, accessories etc.

We want to thank every one of our Creators & Featured creators for spending time looking at preview builds, reporting bugs, and our friends for being our impromptu QA!

We also now have a studio producer, as well as more Audio Studios contracting with us for more music & audio.

The studio is going to be taking a break for the Holiday, and will return right after the new year, to begin Season 2 development; also we have a more in-depth Creator system coming, more details after the holidays!!

There is so much fun stuff coming your way, can't wait to see what 2025 brings!

Happy Holidays to you all, and a very very Happy New Year, warm wishes and a safe holiday from us all over at ChatBattlers!
